attributes.action: Establish a UAP/UFO Reporting service and release UFO related material.
attributes.additional_details:
The people of the UK are losing confidence in government leadership. Many believe important information exists that could improve global stability and reduce hardship, yet the UK continues to prioritise defence activities over transparency.

We request:

a) An official UAP reporting desk,
b) Declassification and release of UAP files,
c) Public access to advanced technologies that could benefit society,
d) A full review of black‑budget spending.
attributes.background: We the people, demand great transparency from the government on the subject of Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena (UAPs). The US has held hearings, passed laws, and created offices to investigate UAPs. Why is the UK falling behind? What national security threats are they keeping quiet?

rejection.details: You may wish to sign this petition, which calls for similar action: "Match US transparency by releasing all existing UAP records" https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/763336
